caption_link.limitation: The source provides matching numeric IDs only. It does not provide an original post URL, date, media link, or an explicit asset-to-caption key.

inspection.evidence_scope: Source-bound start, material-intermediate, and near-complete frames were extracted from the original local GIF and visually inspected at full canvas size; metadata came from that same source file.

motion_sampling.method: Three source-bound frame samples extracted from the original local GIF for review; no derivative was added to the corpus.
motion_sampling.limitation: Three sampled frames establish the observed state change, not a frame-by-frame reconstruction of timing or platform playback.

visual_anatomy.title: A centered numerical promise spans the middle band; its outcome phrase is isolated inside a lavender outlined capsule while the surrounding wording stays in large plain sans.
visual_anatomy.layout: Five horizontal bands, separated by thin rules, arrange fifteen compact principle cards around the central title bank in changing three-, two-, and four-card groupings.
visual_anatomy.reading_order: Upper card bands → central promise and two flanking cards → lower card bands, with each card readable as a self-contained unit.
visual_anatomy.typography: Oversized geometric sans for the promise, a deliberately rough display accent inside the capsule, bold uppercase card labels, and smaller sans summaries with attribution lines.
visual_anatomy.colour: Lavender, pink, aqua, and pale blue rotate across the cards; a soft translucent lavender halo sits behind the central promise.
visual_anatomy.surface: Near-white ground, fine lavender separators and outlines, lightly elevated rounded cards, restrained diffuse shadows, and a soft blurred central glow.
visual_anatomy.modules: Fifteen repeated cards, each with a named principle, one short interpretation, and an attribution strip.
visual_anatomy.density: Medium-high: the count is large, but the repeated card anatomy keeps each item independently scannable.

motion.observed_state_change: The card field and wording remain fixed in the sampled states while the soft lavender glow behind the central promise shifts and blooms; no principle is activated, reordered, or changed.
motion.motion_job: Decorative attention pulse around the promise; the information model remains wholly static.
motion.limitation: Three sampled frames establish the observed state change, not a frame-by-frame reconstruction of timing or platform playback.

transferable_mechanism.reader_job: Scan a high-count set of compact heuristics without losing each item’s core takeaway or attribution.
transferable_mechanism.argument_shape: Curated reference atlas with small multiples.
transferable_mechanism.mechanism: Use repeated self-contained micro-cards and band-level grouping so a long list becomes a finite spatial reference rather than a wall of text.
transferable_mechanism.use_condition: Use only when the items can honestly share one repeated information template, their qualifications remain available, and the count is earned rather than inflated.

anti_copy_boundary: Do not reuse the source’s title claim, principle selection, author attributions, band arrangement, card geometry, lavender marker tag, palette assignment, glow treatment, or looping pulse.

claim_boundary.note: The visual asserts that its principles are proven and visibly associates them with named people and dates. Neither those assertions nor the caption pairing are independently verified by this corpus.
